spec.allocation_definition: r=(active I2000/output0 RMS divided by active I2010/output1 RMS)/(the same ratio in this geometry original equal1Vpp drive). This is a RELATIVE multiplier, never an absolute equal-current target.

spec.current_definition: Active carrier RMS magnitudes determine achieved absolute I0/I1. Both independent output currents including induced inactive-output currents at each carrier are retained in every RMS/power calculation.
spec.circuit: Original two outputnodes/commonGND/one50ohm peroutput; inactive ideal output0V through50ohm. Scaling a carrier scales its entire original solved field/current state; no topology change.
spec.powers: Source/layer/contact signed complex powers and50ohm real losses scale separately by each carrier a_f squared; no whole-condition single factor is substituted for unequal carrier weights.
spec.baseline_caps: Original unscaled B0 first8 electrical values; same V/current bookkeeping/real power/joint8 burden comparisons remain separate. Above-1Vpp normalized predictions explicitly report required voltages.
spec.alias_policy: r1 copies original metrics and points to original scalar/raw SHA/readback identities; no redundant angular evaluation and no duplicate potential/vector archive.
